description: IBM CryptoLite for C (CLiC) is a C software package providing advanced cryptographic services in a configurable footprint. CLiC supports NSA Suite B encryption and ordinary public key encryption, digital signatures, symmetric ciphers, hash functions, message authentication codes, and other cryptographic services with a simple programming interface.
